cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll introduce you to the curator if you hang my exhibition. I taught you to paint; now let's work on getting you noticed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hang it Saturday. Can I have her portfolio requirements now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're finally preparing. Collect my frames and I'll send you the list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Give me her email; I'll ask her directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Initiative! Your teacher's proud. Direct access comes with taking the show down on Sunday. You'll learn the whole exhibition cycle before you meet her.

reason: Make the specific pupil assessment, correction or influence claim shape the pursuit and the response to each partner contribution.
